Page.SourceString: 他被困在了这里，等待着有人将其解放。
Page.LocalizedString: He is trapped here, waiting for someone to set him free.

Page.SourceString: 光是他们的囚笼，禁锢他们的行动。想要寻得安全，就要光的庇护。
Page.LocalizedString: Light is their prison, binding them in place. If you seek safety, stay within its protection.

Page.SourceString: 每个人都有阴暗的往事，若被它们所捕获，便会成为一道黑影，永远地徘徊于黑暗之中。
Page.LocalizedString: Everyone has a dark past. Those consumed by it become shadows, condemned to wander the darkness forever.

Page.SourceString: 三盏灯是他的封印，熄灭全部的灯光便可将其释放。请将其带回吧，这里不是他该在的地方。
Page.LocalizedString: Three lamps form his seal. Extinguish them all to set him free. Please bring him back. He doesn't belong here.

Page.SourceString: 那些弱小的黑影，无法逃离此地。
Page.LocalizedString: Those feeble shadows will never escape this place.

Page.SourceString: 再坚持一下，再坚持一下，光明的未来在等着我……
Page.LocalizedString: Just hold on a little longer, just hold on a little longer… A bright future is waiting for me…

Page.SourceString: 既不是美梦，也不是噩梦……有点没劲呢。
Page.LocalizedString: Neither a sweet dream nor a nightmare… Boring.

Page.SourceString: 这就是我所期盼的「光明的未来」吗？
Page.LocalizedString: Is this really the "bright future" I once hoped for?

Page.SourceString: 新的开始！希望能在这里交到好朋友。
Page.LocalizedString: A new beginning! I hope I make good friends here.

Page.SourceString: 我不想再过这样的日子……能让我解脱吗……
Page.LocalizedString: I don't want to live like this anymore… Can you set me free…?

Page.SourceString: 我从小就讨厌插队，这是不道德的行为。可是别人插队到我前面的时候，我没有办法。毕竟不是什么大事，要是与人争论说不定会闹出更大的乱子。但我今天不知哪来的勇气，呵斥了插队的人。话说出口，周围很安静，我很害怕。然后，插队的人乖乖排到了队伍后面。我身后的人拍了拍我的肩膀。我似乎做了正确的事情，我很开心。我现在会为这些小事开心上好一阵子。
Page.LocalizedString: I've hated cutting in line ever since I was a child. It's just not right. But whenever someone cuts in front of me, I never know what to do. It's not exactly a big deal, after all, and arguing with them might cause an even bigger scene. But today, I somehow found the courage to tell the person off. The moment the words left my mouth, everything around me went quiet. I was terrified. Then, the line-cutter obediently went to the back of the line. The person behind me patted me on the shoulder. I guess I did the right thing. I felt pretty good about myself. I think I'll be happy about this little victory for quite a while.

Page.SourceString: 我的故事，其实并不值得被讲述……不过，这是属于我自己的独一无二的故事。不出类拔萃也可以，我仍然拥有自己的幸福。我现在正在做一个不会醒来的美梦。谢谢你听我说这些，祝你也能有自己的美梦——无论是平凡的还是出众的——祝你心满愿足。
Page.LocalizedString: My story, honestly, isn't worth telling… But it's a one-of-a-kind story that's only mine. It's okay not to stand out. I'm still quite content. Right now, I'm in a beautiful dream I'll never wake from. Thank you for listening. I hope you find a beautiful dream of your own, too—whether ordinary or extraordinary—and may all your wishes be fulfilled.

Page.SourceString: 接近了，接近了，那个孩子就在这里。

Page.SourceString: 请一直注视着它吧，孩子就要回家。

A flashlight is a must for exploring Spooky Cookies! I'll need to grab Spare Batteries along the way and swap them in as needed. If my flashlight runs out of power, it'll be pitch-black, and I won't be able to go any farther…

致胆敢吓唬海特洛最强恶灵的鬼管家：

To the Ghost Butler who dared to scare the most fearsome evil spirit in Hethereau:
Legend has it that if a TV appears in the castle at midnight, its screen flickering with static, you must never turn it off.
Look closely… A pale face slowly takes shape in the static, staring straight at you, perfectly still.
Then you realize… she's crawling out of the screen, inch by inch.
Heh-heh! Scared yet?
—Xiaozhen, the Most Fearsome Evil Spirit in Hethereau
(P.S. Sorry! Xiaozhen still hasn't gotten over that scare the other day. She insisted I write this note for her. You don't mind, do you, Mr. Butler…?)

**：
你最近怎么样？上次联系之后已经过了很久了，房间收拾好了吗？
我和你爸很高兴看到你的改变，你要不要问问你那个朋友，他们的公司还招人吗？我还是希望你有个工作。
等方便去看你的时候，告诉妈妈。
爱你。
Page.LocalizedString:
**:
How are you doing? It's been a while since you contacted us. Is your place cleaned up now?
Your dad and I are happy that you're trying. Do you want to ask your friend if his company is hiring? I still hope you have a job.
Let mom know when to visit.
Love you.
